infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Alibi uses your camera to record video evidence during police encounters and incidents.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Alibi uses your microphone to capture audio evidence that can be cryptographically vaulted.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Alibi uses your location to provide navigation, calculate earnings, and embed GPS coordinates in evidence records.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Alibi uses your location in the background to continue navigation and evidence logging even when the app is minimized.
